Exports:
    - New export, `exports["lb-phone"]:SetPhonePartiallyVisible(0-100)`, allows you to control how much of the phone should show.
    - Added a new export, `exports["lb-phone"]:ForwardCall(source, options)`, that allows you to forward a custom call before it has been answered.
  InstaPic:
    - Added support for Cloudflare Realtime SFU for InstaPic live, to improve performance with many viewers.
    - Added a new export `exports["lb-phone"]:PostInstaPic(username, media, caption, location)`.
    - The InstaPic app now gets properly reset when switching between phones with unique phones enabled.
    - Fixed a rare bug that would cause a crash in DMs
  Garage:
    - Made garage vehicle icons configurable per car.
    - Fixed the garage app being laggy with plenty of cars in it, now it uses virtualized loading.
  Birdy:
    - Fixed several UI bugs in the birdy app, where you couldn't see / properly scroll in Birdy comments.
    - The Birdy app now gets properly reset when switching between phones with unique phones enabled.
  Camera:
    - Fixed a bug that would cause the rear camera in portrait mode to take landscape photos.
    - Fix camera/gamerender size not rendering correctly on 5K.
  Locales:
    - Added missing localizations.
    - Updated English (`en.json`).
    - Updated German (`de.json`).
    - Updated Spanish (`es.json`).
    - Updated French (`fr.json`).
    - Updated Hungarian (`hu.json`).
    - Updated Portuguese (`pt-br.json`).
    - Updated Romanian (`ro.json`).
    - Updated Ukrainian (`ua.json`).
  Other:
    - Added support for company calls for dynamic & custom numbers.
    - Fixed several UI bugs in the photos app, regarding navigation & loading.
    - Fixed a bug in the message app that would open the wrong conversation at rare times.
    - Fixed a bug that would duplicate individuals in the services employee list.
    - Fixed a bug where the search within the Marketplace app wouldnt work properly.
    - Fixed new line formatting on m
